It Was Boat Diving, during the morning. in High Tide. The place is a Rock Formation in the middle of the sea. When we approach the dive site, Whale Shark Appears and was with us the hole diving. He was there during 3 following days.

Tanjung Lang, north of Pulau Redang. Depth of the dive site is around 25m, but whale shark was sighted at the surface between 1m - 5m. At one time, it dive down to almost 20 meters and away from us, and was out of sight, but in less than a minute, it came back, circling us. Specimen was very curious and circled a group of 15+ divers and 2 dive boats, for more than 30 minutes, sucking in and playing with bubbles from scuba divers. Specimen is accompanied by Remoras (Echeneis Naucrates) and Cobias (Rachycentron Canadum)

Off Redang, Pulau Lima - Southern Tip. One whale shark was sighted between 1m - 10m. Circling a group of 6 divers. sucking in and playing with bubbles from scuba divers. After about 20 minutes, another whale shark was sighted. Both whale sharks circled us for more than an hour. We had to leave eventually, while the whale sharks are still circling our boat. There has been several sightings of whale shark around Pulau Redang, though it's not common. And to have 2 whale shark apearing at the same time is rare. Specimen is accompanied by Remoras (Echeneis Naucrates) and Cobias (Rachycentron Canadum)

Our group took a whale shark tour, traveling from the port at 0800 around 1 hour to Parque Nacional Isla Contoy ($10 fee to enter). We drove around for about 45 minutes before the guide said this individual was spotted by another boat. When we got on scene just after 0930 over 8 vessels were taking turns letting 2 people enter the water to swim with this shark. We waited patiently for about another hour until we got to see this amazing creature. By the time our group left at 1130 there were over 12 vessels waiting to see the only whale shark for the day. The guides were respectful to each other and enforced that only 2 people can swim at a time and not to touch the animal. We got within a meter from it at one point as it surfaced to forage on plankton. It appeared to be indifferent to the people and boats around it. The tour guide said that peak season is July, which ironically is also hurricane season when it gets more troublesome.
